summary: NRx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing an FDA Office of Generic Drugs communication reclassifying its ANDA amendment for preservative-free ketamine from a Major Amendment to a Minor Amendment. The FDA revised the GDUFA goal date to November 10, 2026, noting the amendment requires no substantial agency resources. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a regulatory milestone update, not a special situation; watch the November 10, 2026 action date as the near-term binary catalyst for NRXP.
